- Added metadata and icon files for better integration and identification.
- Changed daily report folder structure: now supports recursive scanning of subdirectories such as C:\Users\***\Desktop\WorkBuddyFile\第*周.
- Expanded report summary structure: increased from two to three core categories (includes a new "个人反思" section).
- Updated summary and output rules to match the new three-category format, maintaining focus on concise, clear, and authentic reporting.
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file from the repository.

- Initial release of weekly-report-auto skill.
- Automatically scans and summarizes all Markdown (.md) daily reports from C:\Users\zsj\Desktop\WorkBuddyFile for the current week.
- Integrates daily work content, removes duplicates and irrelevant details, and outputs a concise weekly report.
- Report output is split into two main sections—practical work summary and learning summary—with clear point-by-point details.
- Generates an actionable plan for the following week based on the past week's work and learning outcomes.
- Uses a natural, realistic tone to accurately reflect real work without artificial or generic phrasing.
